description:
Helping Hands app becomes a design viewer first: on launch, open straight to the newest design with no menus to get through first.

Jake's words: "Also update Helping Hands too. When we drop a new design on there, when we first land in the app, we should be able to see that design directly. Helping Hands right now should just be a design viewer platform. So we should see the first item right there."

Spec:
- On launch the app opens directly to the newest design (e.g. the 3D gripper model from pebble voice-6d8b9fd8: rendered 3D model/STL viewer with rotate/zoom, plus its images). No menus first.
- When an agent drops a new design into the repo, it shows up as the first item the next time the app opens (or live).
- Other designs are reachable by swiping or a simple list.
summary: Helping Hands should open straight to the newest design, such as the 3D gripper STL viewer with rotate and zoom, instead of menus. New designs dropped into the repo should appear first on next open, with older designs reachable by swiping or a simple list.
